item.title: Galdes must go, but Jason Azzopardi must not be the one leading the crusade
item.description: The political arguments against an unfit minister should be left to a political party that has nothing to hide, preaches ethics as a measure of propriety and not be dictated by a hypocrite

item.title: MIDI sells more of Tigne Point for €10.2 million
item.description: MIDI plc has entered into a promise of sale agreement with Basel Capital Ltd covering 11 commercial premises and Unit T3 at Tigne Point • Company says it will use net proceeds to redeem €50 million bond

item.title: Construction worker fighting for his life after three-storey fall in Santa Venera
item.description: The victim fell at around 8:15am on Monday in Triq Kanonku Bonnici

item.title: Man falls after entering construction site at 4am
item.description: Police said that in the early hours of Monday, the 43-year-old man who lives in Għargħur entered the construction site in Triq il-Kbira, Mellieħa

item.title: Right of reply: Only two registered objectors to Valletta carpentry workshop sanctioning
item.description: Planning Authority approved sanctioning of Valletta carpentry workshop with one condition prohibiting the use of spray equipment

item.title: Asylum seeker detained for suicidal thoughts had human rights breached, court rules
item.description: Court takes immigration authorities to task for detaining asylum seeker over "secret intelligence" that suggested he was experiencing suicidal thoughts

item.title: Court rejects AGs attempt to charge two men for contempt of court after they were already fined
item.description: The court had already taken disciplinary action against the men for their failure to appear in court

item.title: Chestnut soup
item.description: Celebrate Christmas with this warming chestnut soup, gently spiced with orange and cinnamon, slow-cooked in tomato and wine, and served in a bread bowl, homemade by Daniel Pisani from Marrow

item.title: Mixed weather forecast for Christmas, Met Office warns
item.description: Mild temperatures are expected to persist over the festive period, but cloud, showers and strong winds could affect Christmas Eve night and Christmas Day, according to the Meteorological Office

item.title: Boy, five, hospitalised after being hit by car in Qormi
item.description: Police said the boy was hit at around 7:30am in Triq l-Imdina
